title.zh: 保留共同引用的跨表述形成对应
title.en: Cross-articulation formation matching with retained references

claim.zh: 不同片段载体的有限配置若初始位置数相同且对保留引用的全部分支问题同测，在固定输入对有限结果条件下，每个有限形成命令序列都有相应历史，保留原配置、同测结果及位置对齐。同一实际过程的精确说明必须区分空历史与已消耗历史。
claim.en: Finite configurations over different fragment carriers with equal initial slot counts and agreement on all retained-reference branch questions match every finite formation command sequence under finite fixed-pair outcomes, preserving the original configuration, final answers and slot alignment. Exact accounts of the same actual process must distinguish its idle and spent histories.

hypotheses.zh: 两侧 FiniteOutcomes；全部有限否定、合取与位置对接续问题同测；相同初始位置数。
hypotheses.en: FiniteOutcomes on both sides; agreement on all finite negation, conjunction and slot-pair continuation questions; equal initial slot counts.

hypotheses.zh: 每步从同一配置选择两个位置并追加有见证的结果，原位置保持不变。不可抹去区别的具体定理只需 Exact，不需有限性或 Reduced。
hypotheses.en: Each step selects two slots in the same configuration and appends a witnessed result while retaining old slots. The concrete unavoidable-distinction theorem only needs Exact, not finiteness or Reduced.

correspondence.zh: 编号是配置内部位置，可引用之前形成的结果；没有共同原生对象名。形成安排语义不自动是破坏性资源的实际执行。
correspondence.en: Indices name positions internal to the configuration and can reference earlier formed results; no common native object names are supplied. Formation-arrangement semantics is not automatically execution with destructive resources.

detail.zh: 位置对接合的有限结果给出有限分支，再复用恢复及历史提升。
detail.en: Finite outcomes of slot-pair joining give finite branching, then reuse recovery and history lifting.

output.zh: 同测配置的后继匹配及有限路径提升。
output.en: Successor matching and finite trace lifting for equally answering configurations.

input.zh: retained_pair_result_matches 固定两个位置；retained_history_matches 保留命令序列并由 trace_length 保持对齐。
input.en: retained_pair_result_matches fixes both slots; retained_history_matches preserves commands and uses trace_length for alignment.

conditions.zh: 每对输入有限结果、问答一致和初始位置数相同分别明示。
conditions.en: Finite outcomes per pair, question agreement and equal initial slot counts remain explicit.

detail.zh: 仅具体修复见证使用退化反例；一般匹配定理不依赖该反例。
detail.en: Only the concrete repair witness uses the collapse counterexample; general matching does not depend on it.

output.zh: retained_anchor_separates 的真实自接合差异。
output.en: The actual self-joining difference in retained_anchor_separates.

input.zh: singleton_self_question 将该差异接到保留位置命令；retained_question_corrects_coarse_failure 检查修复。
input.en: singleton_self_question connects the difference to a retained-slot command; retained_question_corrects_coarse_failure checks the repair.

conditions.zh: 同一 budgetProcess 及实际 spent 历史；没有改换现象或自由谓词。
conditions.en: The same budgetProcess and actual spent history, without changing the phenomenon or a free predicate.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 不推出任意实际分节的初始问答一致、记忆取得、资源复制许可、概率、循环或基本接合粒度变化；一般恢复含标准经典依赖。
detail.en: Does not establish initial question agreement for arbitrary actual articulations, acquired memory, permission to copy resources, probabilities, cycles or changes of primitive joining granularity; general recovery retains standard classical dependencies.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。槽数相同的相同配置匹配每一形成路径，保留起点并使槽对齐，无有限也无判定（Joining.retained_history_matches）；以外围的假设加排中律亦然（Joining.retained_history_matches_of_em）。在此能与自身结合的片段与不能者由一检验区分，每一对这些检验精确的描述都给它们不同编码（retained_apart、retained_codes_apart；桥接 every_exact_account_retains_real_difference_by_core）。外围的关联步、答案相同与跨度经带重叠通配分支的匹配定义（登记研究的步经 xs[i]?），其编译后的定义用到 propext，凡提及它们的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以此主张在核心的角色框架（Joining.roleFrame）或保留框架（Joining.retainedFrame）上重述，不是逐字实例；桥接表明外围的开映射与局部有限即核心的（openMap_iff_incidence、locallyFinite_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Alike configurations of equally many slots match every course of formation, keeping where they started and keeping the slots aligned, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.retained_history_matches); under the periphery's hypotheses with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.retained_history_matches_of_em). Here a fragment that joins with itself and one that does not are told apart by one test, and every description exact for these tests gives them different codes (retained_apart, retained_codes_apart; in the bridge every_exact_account_retains_real_difference_by_core). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
